race.comment: DE LAGO'S ROCK (7) has the right profile after two thirds this campaign, the latest at this venue when beaten just under a length after travelling well and fighting hard. He gets Pike on board now third-up from an inside barrier and he looks set to run to a new level today. Can land the knockout blow. FROSTED WARRIOR (3) is coming off a Belmont second where he covered ground and was still beaten just under a length, with Chris Parnham staying a plus. It's his first try at the mile, but he's giving every indication he should relish the trip. Can go one better without surprising. SYLVA JACK (2) comes back in trip today off a 42-day freshen. He has performed well on the fresh side previously and the winkers go on. Keep safe. ALL THE RAGE (11) is third-up now and comes through the same race as DE LAGO'S ROCK last time. Needs some luck from the draw but he won't be far away.
